mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.5% (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 4.0% signals labor market overheating that triggers inflation concerns and potential rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate weakening demand for goods/services, leading to negative equity returns due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of periods when RSAFS and HOUST both decline (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In high industrial production regimes (INDPRO > 105), a subsequent decline in industrial output signals manufacturing slowdowns that reduce corporate profit growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of periods when INDPRO > 105 and declines (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Positive GDP growth (GDPC1) signals expanding economic activity that increases corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in >60% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL rising above 250.0 indicates accelerating inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 250.0 (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Joint increases in employment (PAYEMS) and declines in unemployment (UNRATE) signal extreme labor market tightness that fuels wage inflation and rate hike expectations, causing negative equity returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), a further decline in unemployment signals overheating that triggers central bank rate hikes, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0 and declines (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).
